subject: Remove endian coverage from server.c (#492)
reason: The diff only removes the endianconvTest entry from the serverTest table in server.c, the registry for the built-in unit-test harness (`valkey-server test <name>`). No runtime code path changes: endian conversion functions are untouched, and no command, reply, replication, cluster, or persistence behavior is affected. A fuzzer scenario against a running server cannot reach or distinguish this test-registration removal, so no scenario is needed.
